plugins.name: intent-ops
plugins.description: Full delivery pipeline from feature intent to merged branch (a Jira ticket is optional and enriches the flow when present): spec-writer (DDD spec from a description or Jira ticket), plan-writer (TDD implementation plan), task-runner (subagent-per-task execution with two-stage review), plan-executor (inline execution), worktree-setup, tdd-guide, code-reviewer, review-receiver, branch-shipper. Every stage gated on explicit approval.

plugins.name: project-setup
plugins.description: Language-agnostic workspace tools: codebase-mapping produces a 7-file docs/codebase/ knowledge base, docs-writer writes and edits documentation files, /project-init initializes or syncs CLAUDE.md, /commit generates conventional commit messages.

plugins.name: java-code-standards
plugins.description: Four skills and one rule enforcing a consistent Java coding standard. ICP is a diagnostic tool, not an architectural driver — semantic cohesion over metric decomposition. Tiers: ≤ 7 ideal, 8–9 tolerated when the Abstraction Gate rejects decomposition, ≥ 10 hard block. Balanced coupling (3D model), MC/DC JaCoCo coverage.
